newsitem.title: USA: Lauder sees Q3, FY '97 EPS meeting estimates.
newsitem.headline: Lauder sees Q3, FY '97 EPS meeting estimates.

text.p: Estee Lauder Cos Inc said on Monday it expects its earnings for the third quarter ended March 31 to be in line with analysts' expectations. The company added that it did not know why trading in its stock was so active.
Estee Lauder shares were down 2-1/4 to 43-1/2 on Monday.
The First Call consensus estimate for Estee Lauder's third quarter is $0.25 per share.

Estee Lauder also said it also is comfortable that its financial results for fiscal year 1997 will be in line with analysts' projections. The company said it will report its third quarter results on April 29.
